hypothesis: Selecting the active x/y phase coordinate before modulo-by-3 may compile to a scalar udiv instead of LAB25's vector .xy udiv, preserving exact output while reducing phase arithmetic width.
selection_policy: No parameter sweep. Candidate is admitted only if FXC emits scalar modulo, texture contract remains 1 Gather + 4 SampleLevel worst-case, CPU parity passes, and LAB25/LAB27 WARP outputs are bit-exact on canonical plus stress input.
hardware_policy: No physical GPU test unless the software gate proves a genuinely different compiled scalar-modulo shape.
